name: Emmanouil Kefalogiannis - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT ‘Institutional aspects of artificial intelligence in the context of European integration’
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on how artificial intelligence should be governed. It says decisions must stay in human hands, that people must be able to understand and challenge computer-made decisions, and that the Parliament needs its own expert unit to keep watch. It also calls for stronger protection of rights, fair rules for businesses, and a common European approach to AI worldwide. This is an opinion, not a new law.

- The Parliament wants its own AI monitoring unit and more staff training.
- It asks for new charter rights, such as protection from deepfakes and algorithmic bias.
- Next, the Parliament sends its position to the Council and the Commission.
